title: Narra 4.1.30 — fresh reinstall
message: Sync your account first, uninstall the current Narra app, then install 4.1.30 from the official GitHub release or https://thecub.netlify.app/narra. This is a one-time reinstall; future updates install normally.
changelog: One-time reinstall: sync your account, uninstall the current Narra app, then install this release from an official link.
After Narra 4.1.30 is installed, future updates can install normally.
The anime player now offers Fit, Fill, and Stretch modes with cleaner gesture controls.
Buffering no longer switches servers automatically; choose and retry servers manually.
Megaplay and AniHQ extraction are updated, with failed streams filtered before playback.
Free playback now consistently completes its ad or timed fallback step.
A compact CubeTV showcase appears after Anime Continue Watching and stays remotely configurable.

items.message: Install the same file on both devices. On Fire TV or Android TV, enter Downloader code 3085564.
